title: API Platform Engineer
description: A deep, project-based roadmap for API Platform Engineer: Own API strategy with REST, OpenAPI, gateways, authentication, versioning, governance, developer portals, and reliability.

tree.name: API Platform Engineering Fundamentals
tree.description: Gain a comprehensive understanding of the API landscape, the unique value and responsibilities of an API Platform Engineer, and foundational architectural principles.

resources.title: What is an API Platform Engineer? (Red Hat)
What is an API? - Application Programming Interface
API Design Tutorial - REST API Design Best Practices

children.name: The API Platform Engineer Role and Value
children.description: Define the scope, core responsibilities, and strategic importance of an API Platform Engineer, bridging the gap between API producers and consumers and driving API adoption.

resources.title: The API Platform Engineer: A New Role for the API Economy (Nordic APIs)
What is an API Gateway? A Complete Introduction
Why you need an API Platform Engineer

children.name: HTTP/HTTPS Fundamentals for APIs
children.description: Deep dive into HTTP methods, status codes, headers, statelessness, connection management, caching mechanisms, and the critical role of HTTPS for secure API communication.

resources.title: An introduction to HTTP (MDN Web Docs)
What is HTTPS? And How Does it Work? [Beginner's Guide]

children.name: RESTful API Design Principles & Best Practices
children.description: Master resource-oriented design, idempotency, HATEOAS, proper use of HTTP methods, media types, and practical guidelines for building robust, intuitive, and scalable REST APIs, focusing on the platform perspective of consistency and reusability.

resources.title: Building REST APIs with Node.js and Express (Mosh Hamedani)
REST API Design Guide: Principles and Best Practices
REST API Crash Course - Design Principles & Best Practices

children.name: API Description & Specification (OpenAPI/Swagger)
children.description: Learn to define, document, and generate code for APIs using OpenAPI Specification (OAS), understanding its role in API-first design, tooling integration, code generation, and enhancing developer experience across the platform.

resources.title: OpenAPI Specification (formerly Swagger) Tutorial (Build an API with Node.js and Express)

children.name: Exploring Alternative API Architectures (GraphQL, gRPC, AsyncAPI)
children.description: Gain a foundational understanding of alternative API styles: GraphQL for flexible data fetching, gRPC for high-performance microservices communication, and AsyncAPI for event-driven architectures, and their implications for API platform design.

resources.title: GraphQL Course - Full Tutorial for Beginners
gRPC Crash Course | Build REST APIs With Golang & gRPC

tree.name: API Development Workflow & Tooling
tree.description: Master the essential tools and workflows for designing, developing, testing, securing, and documenting APIs, emphasizing an API-first approach and efficient collaboration across the API platform lifecycle.

resources.title: Postman Crash Course | API Testing & Development
Learn REST APIs: A Complete Guide for Beginners

children.name: API Development Clients & Testing Tools
children.description: Become proficient with industry-standard GUI and command-line tools like Postman, Insomnia, and cURL for making requests, inspecting responses, testing APIs, and scripting workflows for API consumption and validation.

resources.title: curl - Everything you need to know
Postman Tutorial For Beginners | Full Course
cURL Command Tutorial - Mastering HTTP Requests in the Command Line

children.name: API Design & Specification Tools
children.description: Explore and utilize specialized tools for visual API design, OpenAPI specification creation, validation, linting, and maintaining a consistent API catalog. Examples include Stoplight Studio, SwaggerHub, or Postman's design capabilities.

resources.title: Learn OpenAPI (Swagger) in 15 Minutes - REST API Documentation

children.name: Version Control Systems (Git & CI/CD Basics)
children.description: Master Git for collaborative development, managing API specifications, code, and configurations, and understanding its integration with CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, building, and deployment of APIs and the platform itself.

resources.title: Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course

children.name: API Testing Strategies & Frameworks
children.description: Learn various API testing methodologies (unit, integration, contract, end-to-end, performance, security) and explore popular tools and frameworks like Postman (Newman), SoapUI, Jest, or Cypress. Emphasize contract testing for platform reliability.

resources.title: The Ultimate Guide to API Testing (SmartBear)
API Testing Tutorial for Beginners using Postman
Pact.js - Consumer Driven Contract Testing with NodeJS

children.name: API Automation & CI/CD for Platform
children.description: Deep dive into automating API deployment, testing, documentation generation, and governance checks within continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, crucial for maintaining a robust API platform.

resources.title: Implementing API Gateways in a CI/CD Pipeline (Kong)
What is CI/CD? A Beginner's Guide
Intro To CI/CD With GitHub Actions | DevOps

children.name: API Mocking & Sandbox Environments
children.description: Understand how to create mock APIs and sandbox environments to enable parallel development, frontend integration, robust testing, and faster iteration without dependencies on a fully implemented backend, improving developer agility.

resources.title: Mocking APIs for Faster Development and Testing (Postman)
JSONPlaceholder - Free fake API for testing and prototyping

tree.name: API Security, Authentication & Lifecycle Management
tree.description: Deep dive into securing APIs against common threats, implementing robust authentication and authorization schemes, and managing the API lifecycle from creation to deprecation effectively, ensuring a secure and stable API ecosystem.

resources.title: API Security Course for Beginners - Protect your APIs with OWASP Top 10
OAuth 2.0 - How it Works and Why You Need It

children.name: Authentication & Authorization Mechanisms
children.description: Explore API Key management, OAuth 2.0 (Authorization Flows), OpenID Connect (OIDC), JWTs (JSON Web Tokens), and best practices for secure access control in API platforms, including token validation and refresh strategies.

resources.title: An Ultimate Guide to API Authentication and Authorization (Auth0)
JWT Authentication Tutorial - JSON Web Tokens

children.name: API Security Best Practices (OWASP API Top 10)
children.description: Understand the most critical API security risks identified by OWASP (e.g., Broken Authentication, Excessive Data Exposure, Security Misconfiguration, SSRF) and effective mitigation strategies and security controls for the API platform.

resources.title: Common API Security Vulnerabilities and How to Fix Them (Akamai)
API Security: OWASP API Security Top 10

children.name: API Data Security & Compliance
children.description: Implement robust measures for data security in APIs, including encryption at rest and in transit, protection of Personally Identifiable Information (PII), and ensuring compliance with regulations like GDPR, CCPA, and HIPAA.

resources.title: API Security: How to Secure REST APIs
API Security Best Practices - Protecting your APIs

children.name: API Versioning Strategies
children.description: Learn and evaluate different approaches to versioning APIs (e.g., URI, Header, Query Parameter, Content Negotiation) and their implications for compatibility, evolution, consumer experience, and platform management.

resources.title: Node.js & Express REST APIs Tutorial - 10 - API Versioning
REST API Crash Course - Design Principles & Best Practices

children.name: API Deprecation & Sunsetting
children.description: Develop and implement strategies for gracefully deprecating old API versions, communicating changes to consumers, and managing the entire API sunsetting process to minimize disruption and maintain consumer trust.

resources.title: How to Deprecate an API (Nordic APIs)
API Versioning Strategies - REST API Tutorial

tree.name: API Gateways, Observability & Reliability
tree.description: Focus on the operational aspects of API platforms, including the critical role of API gateways, ensuring high availability, optimal performance, and comprehensive monitoring, logging, and reliability engineering.

resources.title: API Gateway Tutorial for Beginners | What is an API Gateway?

children.name: API Gateway Architecture & Implementation
children.description: Understand the core functions of API gateways (routing, load balancing, policy enforcement, security, request/response transformation, caching) and explore popular platforms like Kong, Apigee, AWS API Gateway, and Azure API Management.

resources.title: API Gateway vs. API Management: What's the Difference? (Kong)
Building a Serverless API Gateway with AWS Lambda (AWS)
What is an API Gateway? | API Gateway Explained
AWS API Gateway Tutorial for Beginners

children.name: API Traffic Management & Policy Enforcement
children.description: Implement and manage advanced traffic management techniques via the API gateway, including intelligent routing, load balancing algorithms, circuit breaking, caching policies, and enforcing security and business rules.

resources.title: Advanced Traffic Management with Envoy Proxy

children.name: Rate Limiting & Throttling
children.description: Implement strategies to control API consumption, protect against abuse, denial-of-service attacks, and ensure fair usage for all consumers while maintaining service stability and adherence to quotas.

resources.title: Rate Limiting: How to protect your APIs (Akamai)

children.name: Infrastructure as Code for API Platform
children.description: Learn to manage and automate the provisioning and configuration of API gateway infrastructure, associated services, and deployment pipelines using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi.

resources.title: Terraform Course for Beginners - Crash Course

children.name: API Monitoring, Logging & Tracing
children.description: Set up comprehensive observability for APIs and the platform itself using key metrics (RED, USE), structured logging, distributed tracing (e.g., OpenTelemetry), and alerting to ensure health, performance, and rapid error detection and root cause analysis.

resources.title: OpenTelemetry Tutorial - Getting Started with OpenTelemetry

children.name: API Resilience & Scalability Patterns
children.description: Explore and implement patterns like circuit breakers, retries with exponential backoff, bulkheads, and caching strategies to build highly available, fault-tolerant, and scalable API platforms capable of handling fluctuating loads.

children.name: Service Mesh Integration for Internal APIs
children.description: Understand the role of service meshes (e.g., Istio, Linkerd) in managing and securing internal APIs within a microservices architecture, and how API Gateways interact with service meshes for boundary control.

resources.title: What is a Service Mesh? (Red Hat)
Service Mesh Explained | What is a Service Mesh?

children.name: API Performance Optimization
children.description: Master techniques for optimizing API response times, including advanced caching strategies (CDN, client-side, server-side), efficient data serialization, payload compression, database query optimization, and load testing.

resources.title: How to Optimize Your API Performance (Appwrite)
API Optimization Best Practices: Caching, Compression, & More!
Build a REST API in Node.js with Express & MongoDB | Advanced Concepts

tree.name: API Ecosystem, Governance & Strategy
tree.description: Understand the broader impact of APIs, how to foster a thriving developer ecosystem, enforce robust governance, and contribute strategically to the overall API product and business strategy for long-term success.

resources.title: REST API Design Best Practices - What Not To Do

children.name: API Product Management Principles
children.description: Learn to treat APIs as products, understanding consumer needs, defining API roadmaps, managing feature lifecycles, and aligning API development with business goals and market demands.

resources.title: API Product Management - Building an API (APIMatic)
The Evolution of API Product Management (Postman)
API Strategy & Product Management | API Management Fundamentals

children.name: API Developer Experience (DX) & Portals
children.description: Learn to build and manage effective developer portals, providing comprehensive interactive documentation, SDKs, code samples, quickstarts, and support to enhance overall developer experience (DX) and drive adoption.

resources.title: What Makes a Good Developer Portal? (APIs.json)
Swagger UI - Visualize and interact with the API resources
What is a Developer Portal? Why do you need one?
Developer Experience (DX) for APIs: Best Practices

children.name: API Governance & Strategic Planning
children.description: Establish organizational standards, design guidelines, best practices, and a clear strategic roadmap for API consistency, quality, security, and long-term evolution across the enterprise, including policy definition and enforcement.

resources.title: Building an API Strategy: The Ultimate Guide (3scale)

children.name: Cross-functional Collaboration & Communication
children.description: Develop skills in collaborating with diverse stakeholders (product managers, developers, operations, security, legal) to ensure API platform initiatives meet business goals, technical requirements, and organizational standards.

resources.title: Working with Cross-Functional Teams (Harvard Business Review)
Soft Skills For Developers - Collaboration & Communication
Developer Relations & Cross-functional Collaboration | API Days

children.name: API Community Engagement & Feedback Loops
children.description: Establish channels for gathering feedback from API consumers, foster an active developer community, and implement continuous improvement processes based on user insights and support interactions.

resources.title: Building a Thriving API Developer Community (Nordic APIs)
The Importance of API Feedback Loops (Moesif)
API Strategy and Developer Experience with Postman API's Kin Lane
What is Developer Relations? ft. Mary Thengvall

children.name: API Analytics & Insights
children.description: Utilize API usage data, performance metrics, and analytics tools to gain critical insights into API adoption, consumer behavior, performance trends, identify areas for improvement, new features, and inform strategic decisions.

resources.title: The Value of API Analytics (Nordic APIs)
Observability for Microservices Tutorial - Monitoring & Logging

children.name: API Monetization & Business Models
children.description: Explore different business models for APIs, including freemium, tiered pricing, pay-per-use, and subscription models, and understand how to enable and manage these on the API platform to generate revenue and strategic value.

resources.title: API Monetization: Top Strategies & Best Practices (Moesif)
Understanding API Business Models and Monetization | API Academy
API Monetization: How to Earn Money with Your APIs
